customManagers.description: prettier and its plugin are pinned in additional_dependencies of the pre-commit hook; the hook rev alone doesn't change the prettier that runs

packageRules.description: Label Python updates like Dependabot did
Label GitHub Actions updates like Dependabot did
Test and lint tooling in one weekly PR (non-major). prek alone came in as 14 separate PRs this year.
The prettier pre-commit hook mirror, the prettier version it runs and its plugin move together
Leave runner labels and action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Our own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR in every repository for each change to them. Our own actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.
